scan.summary: This is your state license to grow recreational marijuana. It covers indoor Tier II production at 2210 Bailey Hill Road, up to 10,000 sq ft of mature plant canopy, and runs through March 2, 2027. It is the agency's own document, so there is nothing in it for you to fix. What matters is renewing on time every year, meeting its five conditions (CTS tracking, worker permits, video surveillance, reporting changes before they happen, premises-only use), and keeping it posted where the public can see it.
scan.freshness_note: This is the current term, issued March 3, 2026 and running to March 2, 2027. There is no newer version to ask for yet. Expect a replacement certificate after the renewal is approved in early 2027.

conditions.title: Use the license only at 2210 Bailey Hill Road. It cannot be transferred to another location or person.
conditions.evidence_expected: A current license showing the Bailey Hill address. Any move or added premises is approved by OLCC in writing before it happens.

conditions.title: Renew every year. The renewal application and fee must reach OLCC at least 20 days before expiration. A complete, on-time application lets you keep operating until OLCC decides.
conditions.evidence_expected: The submitted renewal application, the fee payment receipt, and OLCC's confirmation that it was received, all dated on or before February 10, 2027.

conditions.title: Track every marijuana item in the Cannabis Tracking System (CTS)
conditions.evidence_expected: CTS account access, UID tag orders, and CTS records that match physical inventory, harvests, and transfers

conditions.title: Every employee who handles marijuana items must hold a current OLCC marijuana worker permit
conditions.evidence_expected: A staff roster that lists each handler's worker permit number and expiration date, with copies of the permits

conditions.title: Keep video surveillance at the premises that meets OAR 845-025-1450, and keep recordings at least 90 days
conditions.evidence_expected: A camera coverage map, system settings or a storage log showing 90+ days of retained footage, and maintenance records

conditions.title: Report changes in ownership, premises, or anyone with a financial interest to OLCC before they take effect
conditions.evidence_expected: Copies of change notices filed with OLCC and OLCC's approvals, dated before each change

conditions.title: Display the license at the premises where the public can see it
conditions.evidence_expected: The posted license (a photo of it posted at the site is useful)

scan.confidence_notes: The document is clear and fully readable, and every field was read directly from page 1. The February 10, 2027 renewal date is my own arithmetic (20 days before March 2, 2027); it is not printed on the license. One thing to be aware of: the current published version of OAR 845-025-1190 reads a little differently from condition 2. Under the rule, a licensee who files a timely renewal on or before the expiration date can keep operating while OLCC decides, and OAR 845-025-1070 charges late renewal fees if the application arrives less than 20 days before expiration. Some summaries describe 20 days as a hard cutoff. Filing by February 10 meets either reading, so plan for that date. I did not check the current text of OAR 845-025-1450 to see whether the 90-day video retention figure still matches; I took it from the license. There is no signature on the signature line, which may just be how this copy was rendered. If you need a signed copy, one can be pulled from the OLCC licensing portal. Nothing else is on file, so there is no earlier version to compare against.

OREGON LIQUOR AND CANNABIS COMMISSION
9079 SE McLoughlin Blvd, Portland, Oregon 97222
RECREATIONAL MARIJUANA PRODUCER LICENSE
License number: 020-1004763A8B2
Licensee: Evergreen Botanicals, LLC
Trade name: Evergreen Botanicals
Licensed premises: 2210 Bailey Hill Road, Eugene, Oregon 97405
License type: Producer — Tier II, Indoor
Canopy limit: 10,000 square feet mature plant canopy
Original issue date: March 3, 2022
Current term: March 3, 2026 to March 2, 2027
Expiration date: March 2, 2027
This license is issued under ORS 475C and the rules of the Commission in OAR chapter 845, division 25, and
authorizes the licensee to produce marijuana at the licensed premises named above, subject to those rules and to the
conditions below.
Conditions of this license:
1. The license is valid only for the premises named above and is not transferable to any other location or person.
2. The license must be renewed annually. A renewal application and the renewal fee must be received by the
Commission no later than 20 days before the expiration date. A licensee that has submitted a complete renewal
application before that date may continue to operate until the Commission acts on it.
3. All marijuana items at the premises must be tracked in the Cannabis Tracking System, and every employee who
handles marijuana items must hold a current marijuana worker permit issued by the Commission.
4. Video surveillance meeting OAR 845-025-1450 must be maintained at the premises and recordings kept for at
least 90 days.
5. Any change in ownership, in the premises, or in the persons with a financial interest in the licensee must be
reported to the Commission before it takes effect.
This license must be displayed at the licensed premises where it can be seen by the public.
Issued by the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission
Date of issue for the current term: March 3, 2026
Authorized signature: ____________________ Licensing Director
